method_description: One DAG index; guarded homogeneous resource word, else capacity envelope if component count >= cores, else DAG EFT; zero online scores.
case_selection: Central first six exclusive cells of source6e5099 500-cell matrix. Other494 remain unassigned. Not a Cartesian expansion.
failure_policy: First unsuccessful cell, unknown outcome, observer error, timeout, RSS violation or survivors stops the aggregate six-cell driver; no retries.
resources: Central s7c98 assigned sole macOS worker, max600s aggregate,4GiB sampled RSS; P1 waits for release. No Colab.
offline_costs: uv sync --locked before dispatch; existing fixed source static 500 checks recorded separately; no training or per-case score tables.
comparison: Complete six-cell smoke, official baseline reused. Preserve regressions and exact raw artifacts. This tests frozen6e5099, not later tree/vector constructors.
